01276 Beriy {be:-ri:'}

字源不詳; 形容詞

欽定本 - Berites 1; 1

比利人 = "我的井"
1) 一個按照亞伯和伯瑪迦而命名的種族, 顯然是應該在巴勒斯坦的北部
   (#撒下 20:14|)
record.edic_text:
01276 Beriy {bay-ree'}

of uncertain derivation;; adj

AV - Berites 1; 1

Berites = "my well: of the well"
1) a tribe who are named with Abel and Beth-maachah, and who were
   therefore doubtless situated in the north of Palestine
